title: Grade 1 Social Studies — U.S. Holidays and What They Remember
subject: Social Studies
description: Practice with questions on Independence Day, Veterans Day, Juneteenth, Thanksgiving.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: When is Independence Day in the United States?
What does Independence Day remember?
choices: the declaration of independence from Britain
the first day of every new year

questions.question: Who is honored on Veterans Day?
choices: people who served in the U.S. armed forces
all people who have been president

questions.question: What does Memorial Day honor?
choices: people who died while serving in the U.S. military

questions.question: What does Juneteenth help us remember?
choices: the start of a new calendar year
the opening of the first post office
the naming of the Pacific Ocean
the end of slavery and news of freedom reaching enslaved people in Texas

questions.question: On what date is Juneteenth?
What does Martin Luther King Jr. Day honor?
choices: a leader who worked for civil rights
the first clock in the U.S.
the first trip to the Moon

questions.question: Labor Day honors which group?
What is one common way people in the U.S. mark Thanksgiving?
choices: mark the signing of the Constitution
honor only people who served in war
share a meal and give thanks

questions.question: Which holiday is January 1?
Which holiday's federal name is Washington's Birthday?
choices: the holiday often called Presidents Day

questions.question: A school puts up a display about fair treatment and civil rights. Which holiday best fits?
Which holiday is on November 11?
How are Memorial Day and Veterans Day different?
choices: Both celebrate the first day of summer.
Veterans Day honors only presidents; Memorial Day honors teachers.
Memorial Day remembers those who died in service; Veterans Day honors those who served.
Veterans Day celebrates workers; Memorial Day starts a new year.

questions.question: Which calendar clue points to Labor Day in the U.S.?
Why might a community have a parade on July 4?
choices: to mark the end of a school year everywhere
to honor the first workers in a town

questions.question: Which would help you find the date of a holiday this year?
What does a holiday often give people a chance to do?
A class studies why June 19, 1865, is remembered in Texas. Which holiday will it learn about?
Which two are both national holidays that always fall on the same numbered date each year?
